newsitem.title: USA: Coca-Cola in another dispute over Surge name.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola in another dispute over Surge name.

text.p: Coca-Cola Enterprises said Friday it is trying to resolve another dispute over its use of the Surge name for its new soft drink, which the company plans to launch during the Super Bowl.
The company said Bio-Tech Pharmacal Inc, a family-owned company in Arkansas, established the trademark right on the Surge name for its own drink in 1994.
Coca-Cola said it did not apply for a trademark until February last year and that its application has not been granted.
The company said it was trying to resolve the dispute.
On Thursday Coca-Cola settled a dispute over the name with Babson Bros Co, a private producer of milking machines, for undisclosed terms.
